reviews.text: Fabulous vet ,so good with all our cats. An independent vet rather than a big group. Would highly recommend with a nervous animal

Finally a veterinarian practice in London with brilliant vets and support staff, super knowledgeable, super friendly, kind and professional.  We moved to them at a stage when our dog needed a big operation.  The information pre and post surgery was clear, the aftercare second to none and genuine.  A great environment, modern, stylish and stress free, full of smiles and a team that clearly love their work and each other.  I only wish we'd moved to this practice years ago.

i had one of the best experiences today with an emergency vet visit after my kittens sister had scratched his eye; i wasn’t sure if there would be an availability for such short notice but i had called up and got impeccable service from anna and emma!

anna kept everything so positive and friendly while we waited (in a separate cat waiting area!!) to be seen, she even wrote down my cats name in his arabic spelling (zeytoon!) for me which was the sweetest little touch, and even got the chance to play with him while we waited. she was incredibly personable to everyone who had come in, too, she knew each person by name and recalled them before they even got inside! even after my cats appointment, where emma had given him amazing care (but we’ll get into that in a second) she had helped me schedule in his sister for her microchip appointment, spoke to me in a way that didn’t feel like i was in a veterinary clinic, it just felt like i had made a friend during such a stressful moment. i can’t recommend coming in for a chat more, even if you don’t have a pet!

in terms of emma, i seriously am in love with her, you can really see the love she has for cats and how much experience she has; she was incredibly patient with my cat as it was his first visit, she gave him treats, and spoke to him so sweetly! even when it came down to microchipping him and checking his eyes she was so incredibly gentle, after his appointment with her he had actually fallen asleep from how at ease he was with her! emma also gave me so much peace of mind when it came down to checking his eye, she spoke to me throughout every single detail of the appointment also i was in the loop between it all!

seriously, i can not recommend these girls enough! thank you so much! <3
Always a lovely experience with this team from front of house to the wonderful veterinary team - Woody, Jake & Elwood feel safe & informed as do their owners !!!

My cat, Qiu Qiu, underwent two dental procedures at this practice, both performed by Laura. Following the second surgery, he experienced persistent oral discomfort, required pain medication to eat, and suffered severe weight loss.
At his 22-day post-op check, his surgical sites were still open and inflamed. When a third surgery was suggested, I lost confidence and requested a referral to a specialist hospital for further treatment.
Qiu Qiu had chronic kidney disease, and the prolonged period of poor eating severely impacted his health, leading to further complications and hospitalisation.
Sadly, Qiu Qiu has now passed away. Based on my experience with Laura and this practice, I cannot recommend them.

UPDATE - Response to Owner's Reply

I strongly disagree with the account of events presented in your response and reject your characterisation of what followed.
Oversimplifying the situation to Qiu Qiu merely "not eating well," followed by an offer of further investigations which I supposedly declined, completely omits the critical clinical events, ongoing pain, and complications that occurred during this period. These matters are clearly documented in your own clinical records, written correspondence, and subsequent specialist reports.
As Qiu Qiu’s owner, having witnessed firsthand everything he went through both during and after his treatment, reading your response is deeply upsetting and disappointing.
I have submitted the complete medical records, radiographs, and independent specialist findings to the RCVS for an objective review. We will await the formal outcome of their assessment.
I saw Emma yesterday with our new kitten. She was very helpful and his injection was painless. Always very happy with The Urban Vet.

Came into urban vet regarding my dog and they took really really good care of her.

Big shoutout to Anna who took care of us throughout the process.

I just had the best experience with the Urban Vet and Paul. Archer developed a skin infection and I called in on Saturday morning, despite being busy and last min, they reviewed images very quickly, squeezed an appointment in for us, and Paul was amazing. He didn’t rush at all, he took the time to review Archer’s condition, and carefully evaluate options. For example, he didn’t rush me into doing unnecessary tests, but rather focused on immediate fix. As someone who’s always quite anxious, I really liked his approach where he detailed the reasoning. I felt like it all made sense, and reassured me. Despite having fitted me in, Paul also took the time to send me an email to make sure all recommendations and treatments were detailed in an email so I could remember everything.

Absolutely amazing care — I cannot thank Urban Vets enough. ❤️

After Bruno became seriously unwell, weak, dehydrated and started passing blood, we came to Urban Vets after a very worrying experience at another veterinary practice. From the moment we arrived, they took us seriously and immediately recognised how sick he was.

They treated him, put him on a drip, monitored him closely and, most importantly, recognised that he needed specialist intensive treatment.

Bruno is now stable and responding to treatment, and we genuinely believe Urban Vets played a huge part in getting him the care he needed in time.

Thank you for listening to us, acting quickly and taking such good care of our little boy. ❤️🐶 5 stars without hesitation!
Thank you Helene!
Great team, very caring
My dog had a laparoscopic spaying procedure with Urban Vet and I’m very happy with the service provided. Very professional, responsive and caring. I would highly recommend.

The Urban Vet are truly outstanding.

We have a nervous rescue dog who dislikes being handled, so vet appointments are usually a source of significant stress and anxiety for both him and us. However, the team at The Urban Vet have always been incredibly understanding, calm, and patient, and they genuinely put our dog's welfare first.

Recently, our dog tore his dew claw while chasing a squirrel, which required an emergency visit. My partner was in the middle of a trial shift at a new job and had to leave unexpectedly to take him to the vet. Paul and the nursing team were exceptionally understanding and did everything they could to assess and treat our dog quickly and efficiently, allowing my partner to return to work the following day.

What could have been a nightmare experience for any owner of a fearful dog turned into a remarkably calm and straightforward visit. The treatment and aftercare were explained clearly, and our dog recovered very quickly thanks to the excellent care he received.

Beyond this particular incident, both the veterinary and reception teams have consistently been professional, compassionate, and reliable. We no longer live particularly close to Garratt Lane, but we will happily make the journey for future appointments because the level of care provided by The Urban Vet is genuinely worth it.

Thank you to everyone at The Urban Vet for making such a positive difference to both our dog and our peace of mind. Highly recommended!
Awesome appointment, Bailey looks forward to returning for another visit.

My cat Iris is not a fan of the Vet, it's hard to get her there but once we arrived I felt at ease with Nurses Steph and Ciara who welcomed us and got us settled. Iris could roam the consultation room while waiting for the Vet. Emma was so supportive, kept Iris calm the whole time and examined her carefully with such a gentle manner. I feel confident knowing how to take care of Iris and help her make a full recovery. We had a brilliant, smooth experience. Thank you for being such an outstanding indepedent vet!

I love the Urban Vet, such a lovely practice.  Everybody is so caring and nice.  First class treatment and service.  It really feels like they care, not a quick in and out but will answer your questions and concerns

We've been with the Urban Vet in Wandsworth for more than 3 years.  They're wonderful, absolutely brilliant and, unlike our previous vets, their costs are very reasonable.   I cannot recommend them highly enough.
These are just the best vets you could wish for.  Your pets will be very well looked after with no one pushing into doing more than is necessary.  Highly recommended
Thank you so much Doreen!

Very happy with this vet practice. In addition to excellent veterinary care, all the team are super friendly and helpful. The attention given to the animals (plus humans!) feels personal and warm. The clinic itself is very pleasant- and it is great to have a separate space for cats.
Excellent staff and very patient and understanding with my nervous Vizsla.

Urban Vets is incredible. Over the past two years, they’ve taken exceptional care of my dog through some scary medical unknowns, and I couldn’t be more grateful.

The team is consistently kind, compassionate, and approachable—they always speak to you clearly and respectfully, without overwhelming medical jargon. They take the time to ensure you fully understand all available options and what they mean for your pet.

I truly couldn’t recommend Urban Vets more highly.

As always, everyone at The Urban Vet was very helpful and so lovely - my young dog swallowed some stones and, once we had established that she did need to be seen, they saw her pretty much immediately and resolved the problem with an emetic.  Fortunately, it was soon enough to avoid surgery which otherwise might have been necessary so, although it felt like an expensive folly on my dog's part, it could have been a lot worse if Laura hadn't seen her and acted so swiftly.  They even gave her a little present as it's her 1st birthday!

The entire team at this practice demonstrates exceptional kindness, compassion, and professionalism. I particularly appreciate their holistic approach to pet health, taking the time to consider overall wellbeing rather than just treating isolated issues. It’s clear they genuinely care about both the animals and their owners. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone seeking thoughtful, high-quality veterinary care.
Exceeded all expectations - would highly recommend - responsive, professional and compassionate

i brought my ageing cat Neko to this vets. The vet gave me some options about her care,  but the kindest one was for them to put her to sleep. she left me with her to say goodbye and then came to take her away. Less than a week later i received a lovely card with Neko’s paw prints. Thank you very much for making the experience so much easier.

Urban Vet is a really incredible local independent vets. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for genuine care. They've helped with a few different concerns we've had with our puppy - and I've never felt as though they've tried to rip me off! They've offered helpful advice on time-sensitive matters over the phone and email as part of their care, and ensured we only go in when required. If you're looking for an independent vets - this is a must!
Friendly and professional reception staff and knowledgable vets, especially Paul who is amazing!
Really great humans for our great animals!!  🐕🐶 …
Very nice and attentive staff, helped us out a lot. Feels like they go above and beyond.

Fantastic team
Excellent support

I visited the Urban Vet and they were nothing short of amazing. My cat needed an emergency appointment and after having no luck with my local registered vet surgery, they kindly squeezed me in at the end of their Saturday clinic. Lila at the front desk was so lovely and reassuring, and Emma immediately put my mind at ease with her gentle and patient examination and fast treatment plan. After hydration fluids and anti-nausea medication, my cat is back to her happy, purring self. Thank you Urban Vet!
The team are very friendly and helpful from reception to the vets. They saw me on-time and i didn't feel rushed.
The best, most relaxed vets I’ve ever been to.  Everyone is so professional and friendly.

This vet is such a superb practice! so much that my pup always pulls me in! He has always been taken care of and what I love is that they are in no rush to just give you whatever treatment, even if that would be better for them! Before I got my pup neutered, they referred me to a dog behaviourist as he had been attacked before and started being a bit scared of other dogs! My pup is so healthy since started going there!
Super nice staff, felt reassured and informed after my dog’s visit. Such a lovely and relaxed environment making us both feel calm about it all!

I have been attending this practice for the last three years and visit quite often as my cat has a long-term condition. Paul, along with every single member of the team I’ve met over the years, has always been caring, supportive, approachable and professional. Their kindness and dedication have not only made a real difference to Lupe’s wellbeing, but also to my experience as a first-time, often-overthinking cat owner.
If I could give them 10 stars, I absolutely would!

I can't tell you how fortunate I feel that I found Urban vets in Earlsfield when it was suspected my working cocker had eaten a corn husk. She had never been to this vets before and hated going to my last one but although she had 2 xrays  and major surgery she always went in with a wagging tail. Laura who looked after her was calm, kind and confident and Paul today when I went for her first check up was great.  The surgery does have a calm feel to it and I like that you know which vet you will be seeing. Reception were great too. Thank you too you all. If there was just one thing:I wish there was a way where details of her treatment could be somehow available to the out of hours vets. Maybe in a similar way as the nhs where the computer notes can be accessed by other surgeries.

An enormous thank you to Hannah Zeeta Lucy and Paul - and all the staff at Urban Vets. The Kindness and Compassion you have shown to our pets (and to us) has been such a comfort to us - we always feel we are in safe hands and treated with the utmost professionalism and care. As long time pet owners, we understand that the prognosis is not always good - but knowing that you are doing all you can to treat and help is of great relief. We are so grateful to have found you - you do the hardest job - and I cannot tell you how much it is appreciated. Thank you all so much Janet

To be honest, I don't know how to put into words how amazing this vet practice has been to us over the past 4 years.

Laura and Paul (and formerly Maebh), along with the incredible team of vet nurses and front of house staff (esp Lila!!) have made our experience with a reactive, epileptic rescue so much easier than I ever thought possible.

We moved to this practice from another local practice, and it has transformed our boy's health and my stress about his wellbeing.

They are caring and understanding, but also honest, evidence-based, and conservative in intervention-- always providing you with multiple options.

Yes, the care is pricey, but completely competitive with all London private vet clinics. Even when the news isn't great, I always feel reassured and empowered by their exceptional service.

1000/10 - take your little animal child here!
Absolutely love this vet practice. The whole team is genuinely kind, and so good with my dogs. Such a great, friendly team. Highly recommend 🐾 …

Five-Star Care and Compassion at Urban Vets

We’ve been through a difficult time with our dog’s cancer diagnosis, but the team at Urban Vets has truly been a lifeline. Every single member of staff is incredibly understanding, supportive, and professional, while also being friendly and genuinely compassionate. They’ve gone above and beyond for both of our dogs, providing not just outstanding medical care, but also love and emotional support.

The surgery itself is immaculate—modern, calm, and a truly welcoming environment for both pets and owners. The reception team always greets us with warmth, and we never feel rushed or overlooked. Our dogs are now back to normality, and we can’t thank the Urban Vets team enough for everything they’ve done.

If you’re looking for a five-star veterinary practice, this should be your first and only choice. We highly recommend Urban Vets with absolutely no hesitation. Thank you again to the entire team—you are all so very much appreciated.

Best vet clinic in London. My dog is always so well treated, we did follow Paul because he is incredible and great professional. However, from reception, nurses and other vets we only received the best service.

The team at Urban Vet are absolutely wonderful. My dog Franco basically loves going to the vet as much as he does going to the park now! Everyone - from the vets to the nurses to the receptionists - is incredibly kind, approachable, and genuinely caring.

We've been working through Franco's allergies for months, and they've been with us every step of the way. A special shoutout to Paul, Franco's primary vet, who is one of the kindest, most competent, and passionate vets I've ever met. I really appreciate how he always takes the time to explain the science, pros and cons, and ethical considerations behind every option, so we always feel fully informed and confident in our decisions.

Overall, I couldn't imagine being in better hands. Urban Vet is truly exceptional - I'd recommend them wholeheartedly to anyone looking for a vet who genuinely cares about both pets and people.

The Urban Vet is a modern practice with highly professional staff members  throughout. The head vet and owner Paul Aggarwal is himself the best veterinarian I have ever come across, and his professional knowledge and kind manners mean that great people want to work there. The onsite lab is a bonus för faster answers. The choice of 20 or 40 minutes consultations is clever and means that the staff truly have time to give the best advice and care. The medical care is outstanding but you never feel that your pet is put through any unnecessary treatments or operations, which is the case at some other practices. I can’t recommend this practice enough.
Thank you Michele!
Best vet experience time and time again. Truly grateful for The Urban Vet.

We couldn't wait for the Urban Vet to open, as Paul is a wonderful vet and has looked after all our pets faultlessly over a number of years. Maybe a change of location, but no changes to the high quality service a great care. Highly, highly recommend the Urban Vet.

Our pet had had surgery in one eye for cherry eye at another clinic abroad, but something went wrong, due to an infection in the eye still with the stitches from the surgery.
Friends of ours recommended this vet for a second go at it and we couldn't have landed to better hands. Amazing space for pets, excellent professionals, we are very happy with the follow up, also the communication with them is excellent.
At the time Laura offered us a range of options including bringing an expert surgeon especially for it, in the end it all worked out after two surgeries. A few years gone by now,  her eye is in excellent condition.
We remain grateful for their care to our pet. Unfortunately we we had to register at another vet because we live very far. Although we have decided that if something really bad happens to our dog we will knock their door first straight away.
Excellent. Kind caring and utterly helpful. Full of expertise. See the same vet which is wonderful.

Amazing service
From receiption to the vet
So pleased I have this amazing vet on my doorstep!
Good people. Thorough and caring

We went to Urban Vets since getting out little
Labrador pup and they are super welcoming and accommodating. The team there looked after my pup amazingly and I couldn’t recommend them more highly. We moved slightly further from the practice and so now attend a practice within walking distance but it was a tough decision and if the new place doesn’t workout we will make the trip back as the quality of care at Urban Vets is amazing.
Excellent and compassionate care from the team. Our much beloved cat Yoshi recovered very quickly after our visit, thanks so much for all the care and support over a little bad patch.
Very kind and warm personel . Well run business
Pleasant and thorough  vet. My cat even purred for her.
Paul has been excellent in helping one of my cats with a skin condition! The team are always very helpful.
Saved our dog when he was extremely unwell and being misdiagnosed by our other vet. Thank god for Paul and his team. The service here is 5* and it's almost like functional medicine for pets.

Amazing service.  Super professional , caring and knowledgeable.  Attention to detail in all consultation and honest professionals. Thanks Paul and Laura to really take care of peppo and to all the ladies at reception that have been managing  all the bookings with and extra of patient and support of a nervous dog mum 😀 specially thanks to Laila, very professional, calm and knowledgeable!!!

Amazing vets. They are compassionate, caring and provide outstanding care. They go above and beyond when caring for your much loved pet. I moved to them on a recommendation of a friend and am thrilled I did and have since recommended them to other friends who also have had the same, amazing, experience.
Excellent vets

Truly the most caring and amazing vet I’ve ever worked with. They have always gone above and beyond to care for my elderly pooch with so much love and compassion. They helped us through so much when his time came to an end. We are so grateful to have them! Maebh is the best vet ever and Hannah is a truly wonderful vet nurse - alongside everyone else at the practice who we adore as well!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! <3

This was my first visit at The Urban Vet. What an amazing team. Laura was so kind, warm and professional, not minding my cat walking all over her desk. She introduced me to the surgeon who was going to operate on my cat's teeth and I was able to leave him there feeling assured that he was in experienced and loving hands. I was called after the operation by the veterinary surgeon and able to collect him later that day. I also want to mention the amazing reception staff who so kindly helped me when my cat had an accident in his basket just before I was about to get in a taxi. They quickly swooped into action helping clean it up and thankfully the taxi driver took me home. My boy is now currently curled up on my lap. He's slightly furious that he can only have wet food so I know that he is already feeling better. I also know that if there's any downturn, I can call The Urban Vet. Thank you so much.

Bentos been with them since birth. Never had any problems at all. Sadly we moved away from the area. But recently need some help from the team. No hesitation, everything done with fast and efficient. Specially thanks to Lily, Eloise and Laura. You can always trust them!

We have been using the Urban Vet since our 16 month old dog was a puppy and cannot recommend them highly enough. She has just been spayed and the care she has received has been amazing. Everyone at the practice is super friendly and kind, and it's always easy to get an appointment. Thank you :)
Thank you Maria! <3
A brilliant vet, friendly, clean and the vets give good advice. I would highly recommend!
Emma was just wonderful today and treated Darcy’s eye ulcer.. so knowledgeable calm and thorough. Thank you

Friendly and professional staff. They always take the time to answer all our questions both during the appointment and after. The clinic is very clean and well-organised and the staff at the reception are always helpful and welcoming! Highly recommended!

We recently had a problem with our new kitten who had a reaction to booster jab. The team at Urban were so professional and were able to treat her in emergency. They looked after her and monitored her. She is well on her way to a full recovery. Thank you so much.
Lovely vet. Very informative, don't rush you, and kind and gentle with our cat
Wonderful visit, very friendly and helpful, also Albert was happy in the cat waiting area.  many thanks, would highly recommend

Emma and Paul are excellent vets who truly care about the wellbeing of our Frenchie who has a lot of skin issues. They work really closely with us to create a full care plan and always think about the welfare of our pup. Couldn't recommend them more as other vets are very transactional, whereas we feel really well looked after at TUV.
Thank you!

I really am so impressed with the support, communication and compassion that the amazing team at Urban Vet give.

It’s a place that feels clean, professional and safe, which is what you want for your fur child on stressful visits.

5 🌟

Paul and the team are excellent!
They give the kind  care you want from people entrusted with our animals.
The difference between this independent practice and one owned by a large corporation is night and day.
Thank you so much Chinju!

I'm actually speechless. These guys are like having a privately tailored Veterinary service revolving around your needs and the needs of your pet. They were sooo wonderful, accommodating, kind and professional too. I went in with my 3 Yr …

I can’t thank Paul, Meabh, the nurses and the reception team enough for the kindness and  care they have shown for Finn and for myself. They genuinely care about their animals and also have worked so hard to make his treatment as affordable as possible for us as a family. Kind, compassionate and highly professional care.
